A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''captain''' served in the [[Imperial Guard]] of the Sith Empire during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]], the captain guided the Imperial Guards stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] where they led Imperial forces on [[Guardian Hold Four]]. However, the Barsen'thor and the [[Rift Alliance]] were able to reclaim the base and defeat the captain.
